episode_summary: In this episode, Sam Burke shares his journey from a young real estate agent to a top producer, emphasizing the importance of maintaining high service standards and leveraging YouTube for lead generation. He discusses the power of mindset and visualization in achieving success and offers actionable insights for agents looking to build a strong personal brand and investment portfolio.
